name: intercept-sdr
description: Control and query the iNTERCEPT SDR signal intelligence platform via its REST API. SDR device management, signal decoders (ADS-B, ACARS, POCSAG, rtl_433, weather satellites, APRS, AIS, SSTV, VDL2, DSC, Morse, sub-GHz, TSCM sweeps, drone detection, WiFi/BT, GPS, Meshtastic, space weather), health checks, recording management, satellite passes, audio streaming, frequency scanning, and remote agent control.
author: TheBrandon
